address: 9288 County Road 37 S, Hope Hull, AL 36043

feeding_claim.verbatim: We offer 100% grass-fed beef and feed-supplemented beef

local_areas: anywhere in the south (including Alabama, Mississippi, Tennessee, and north Florida)

notes: Also called Trinity Farms. Homepage names Harvest, Alabama; business address in Hope Hull. Grazing and finishing farm at Letohatchee (Lowndes County); stocker operation in Madison County in north Alabama. Herd of 400 cows and 400 to 600 stocker calves. Offers 100% grass-fed beef and beef fed a home-made non-GMO feed, so category both. Pork is fed all-natural feed with no pasture language. Beef sides and quarters and pork halves; listed example pricing is not for grass-fed beef. Orders by online form, phone or email; home delivery stated as anywhere in the south. Inventory page would not load on 2026-11-08. Found via Bama Beef Sales Directory (Alabama Cattlemen's Association).

availability.note: Site lists a 12 to 16 week wait for beef.
